text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~, thanks for the meal!
Now then... time to pay the bill...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
“—What! You threw out your back!?
Don't try to move! Call an ambulance right now...”

text_block_list.name: Male Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm totally fine!
I can't be slacking off during the lunchtime delivery rush...!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, the shop is in quite a pinch...!
Hey there, Chef! Would you leave this to me?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The first delivery address is... here.
If I hurry and run...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but this delivery box... balance is crucial!
I need to plan the most efficient route so the noodles don't get soggy...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Don't just stand there gaping around.
You're in the way.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Shakur!
You're just in time...! Actually, you see—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“—And so... to put it bluntly,
I would like you to lend us your extraordinary intellect.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Factor in cooking times and your running speed
to navigate the optimal route...? 
Who the hell would do something that annoying?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there's plenty in it for you too.
You'll get data on me running every route at every possible speed.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Lately, she's constantly running on the track while checking the stopwatch
and eagerly taking notes, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd be here at a time like this.
Could it be that you've hit a wall?
...Because your own data simply isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Sharp-eyed little prince, aren't ya...?
Fine then, I'll take you up on that!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Thank you♪
Well then, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's overrr! That was amazing!
Thanks to you, it flew by in no time!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're sure carefree, sheesh... With this sample size...
no matter how you look at it, you're the one getting the short end of the stick, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's not true♪ You helped the shop out, and while running, I made all kinds of discoveries too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This sensation... feels pretty new!
I can't wait for the next race♪
